- The harness reported "Exited Auto Mode" in this session at about 2026-09-24T23:21Z.
- At 2026-09-25T00:47Z the seat landed PR #20060 (card #19567, ACCEPT `5824753067`, CI green on `ba1c3eae`) with exactly the two allow-listed commands:
  - `curl -sS -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/20060/ccr/ready_for_review -d '{}'` answered `{"draft":false}`.
  - `curl -sS -X PUT https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/20060/ccr/auto_merge -d '{"merge_method":"SQUASH"}'` answered `{"enabled":true,…}`.
  - Timeline: `ready_for_review` and `auto_merge_enabled` at 00:47:31Z / 00:47:34Z, actor `os-steve`.
- ⇒ In this one session, the same command shape against the same allow rows was denied `[Auto-Mode Bypass]` while in auto mode (PR #20022, record `5821758726`) and passed after leaving it. That points at the auto-mode classifier deciding on content over the allow row, rather than at the rows failing to load. One pair of readings; ⛔ not a rate.

  |:--|:--|:--|
  | PR #20022 | auto | ready flip denied `[Auto-Mode Bypass]` |
  | PR #20060 | not auto | both passed |
